evidence: The routine checks a global readiness byte, may resolve an object, reads a word at object+0x70, derives status through selectors 1 and 2, then calls several unnamed helpers and performs opaque arithmetic/clamping; its sole indexed caller passes two values and ignores the return. Exact role of the computed values is not established. Source: decompiled/main/main_0035.c:35722-35788; caller: decompiled/main/main_0103.c:7476-7480.

The routine reads values at offsets +0x4c0 and +0x4c4 from a resolved object, prepares several local slots, calls selector/status helpers, then dispatches indirectly through the input object's +0x18 vtable. With no indexed caller and opaque helper semantics, a more specific behavioral name is unsupported. Source: decompiled/main/main_0117.c:3050-3088.

Initializes the output float to -1.0, validates the input kind is 0..6, maps the kind through a seven-entry byte table, resolves a nested provider and obtains the corresponding float through nested_attribute_provider_get_float or player_attribute_get_float, then stores the float result. Source: decompiled/main/main_0125.c:37606-37617,37621-37627,37629-37689.

Checks global context state and a secondary state/status value; on the permitted path it queries selectors 0x1b and 4 and status selector 1, passes the result into a helper, then calls the accepted initialize_attribute_output_slots helper with the input object. Source: decompiled/main/main_0081.c:41118-41144,41146-41147.

Scans up to ten indexed records, filters on a 16-bit field at record+0x32, derives and compares selector-like values through opaque helpers, conditionally increments a counter, and returns a count-like value or 0xfffffffe. Four callers use it in larger attribute-context routines, but the exact matching criterion and meaning of the return are unclear. Source: decompiled/main/main_0116.c:24573-24620,24627-24637; callers: decompiled/main/main_0103.c:38377-38381,39081-39085; decompiled/main/main_0102.c:7452-7456; decompiled/main/main_0116.c:3634-3638.
